title: account_info
key_points: The account_info method retrieves detailed information about a given XRPL account.
It returns an object containing fields such as accountID, ledgerVersion, balance, domain, subdomain, and flags.
This method requires authentication with an API token.
limitations: Scope is limited to the specific account queried.
More context may be needed for full understanding of how this method fits into XRPL ecosystem
asserts: Calling the account_info method on a validated XRPL account returns detailed information about that specific account, including balances and domain info. Authentication with an API token is required.
